national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority and ₹10,000 Crore SME Growth Fund
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the establishment of the Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA) as the apex body for integrated transport and logistics planning in the country.

ITLA will formulate a long-term National Transport Master Plan with a 10-year horizon covering roads, railways, ports, civil aviation, inland waterways, and urban mobility, complementing the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan and National Logistics Policy.

The authority will monitor infrastructure projects costing above ₹500 crore and the Cabinet additionally sanctioned a ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund to provide equity capital to high-potential Small and Medium Enterprises.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Launches Naval Infrastructure Projects at Hindustan Shipyard Limited
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched Fleet Support Ship-1 ('Surya'), laid the keel for Fleet Support Ship-5, and inaugurated upgraded Slipway-4 and a 300-tonne Goliath Crane at Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) in Visakhapatnam.

The newly launched Fleet Support Ship-1 is designed to enhance the Indian Navy's operational reach, endurance, and capability as a first responder and preferred security partner in the Indian Ocean Region.
HSL attained Miniratna Category-I status in 2025, reflecting its improved financial position and crucial role in meeting India's domestic defence manufacturing goals towards Viksit Bharat 2047.

national_news.title: India's National Telemedicine Service eSanjeevani Crosses 50 Crore Teleconsultations
bullets: India's National Telemedicine Service, eSanjeevani, crossed the milestone of 50 crore cumulative teleconsultations across all States and Union Territories, emerging as the world's largest telemedicine implementation in primary healthcare.

Developed by C-DAC Mohali under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the platform currently supports over 1.42 lakh Ayushman Arogya Mandir spokes, 19,000 medical hubs, and operates in 15 languages.

Women account for over 57 percent of total utilization, and the platform recently integrated an AI-powered Clinical Decision Support System (AI-CDSS) which won the Gold Award under the National Awards for e-Governance 2026.

national_news.title: India and Switzerland Ink Five Agreements to Enhance Bilateral Ties and Mobility
bullets: India and Switzerland signed five agreements in New Delhi covering Migration and Mobility, Young Professionals Exchange, Transportation Technologies, Innovation, and DST-SNSF research collaboration.
PM Modi highlighted the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) with EFTA nations, aiming to attract $100 billion in investment and create 10 lakh direct jobs over 15 years.
Both countries agreed to deepen cooperation across defense production, military exchanges, nuclear energy, life sciences, biotechnology, and trusted supply chain development.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Pushes Infrastructure and Governance Initiatives in Rohtas District
bullets: Inaugurated the 9.2-km Beda-Mokar Sasaram Bypass and inspected the Beda Flyover in Rohtas district to boost regional connectivity.
Unveiled an astronomy laboratory at the PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya in Karup Panchayat (Shivsagar block) and reviewed local pond renovation under the 'Kayakalp Abhiyan'.
Participated in the 'Seva Setu Abhiyan' support camp and addressed the 'Yuva Samvad' program in Jamuhar, highlighting key law-and-order and women safety commitments.
